title: CHED to safeguard critical thinking as AI reshapes higher education

blocks.text: PANGLAO ISLAND, Bohol — The Commission on Higher Education (CHED) is strengthening its policies on artificial intelligence (AI) to ensure that the technology enhances instruction without compromising students’ ability to think critically and logically. CHED chairperson Shirley Agrupis said the agency recognizes the importance of AI in education but stressed that the quality of learning must remain anchored on human intelligence and critical thinking.
